slides.texte_overlay:
How to master the art of
being able to talk to anyone

Use their name early.

Once in the first minute.
People relax when they
hear their own name.

Ask "how did you get into that?"

Everyone has a story behind
what they do. Let them tell it.

Know a little about a lot.

History, science, travel.
A small fact opens any door.
slides.texte_sophia:
Know a little about a lot.

I learn a small fact a day
on the Sophia app.
It opens any door.

slides.texte_overlay:
Match their energy first.

Calm with calm, fun with fun.
Then lead the conversation.

Remember one detail.

Next time, ask about it.
That's how people feel seen.
